## Why This Is Asked

- Kubernetes namespaces, Namespace RBAC

- Observability: logs/alerts for cross-tenant activity

## Code Example
```javascript
# Kubernetes NetworkPolicy example (deny by default)
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-all
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
```

```javascript
# Istio AuthorizationPolicy example (per-tenant)
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-api
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  rules:
  - from:
    - source:
        principals: ["cluster.local/ns/tenant-a/sa/tenant-a-api"]
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle ephemeral tenants with frequent churn while keeping isolation?
